$description: ZIGURAT AI-AECO Master — Group 2 FMP design system. Brand colours were sampled by pixel-inspection of the official Zigurat logo mark (assets/logo/zigurat-logo.jpg): the two-tone isometric ziggurat in electric blue and mint green. Both values are exact matches of the dominant non-white pixels in that file.

electric-blue.description: Primary. Exact sample from the logo's blue face. Use for primary actions, links, key data series.

electric-blue-dark.description: Hover / active / pressed state for electric-blue.

electric-blue-tint.description: Tinted background for info callouts and selected rows.

mint-green.description: Primary. Exact sample from the logo's green face. Use for success, positive value delta, secondary data series.

mint-green-dark.description: Hover / active state, and the accessible text-on-light variant of mint-green.

mint-green-tint.description: Tinted background for success callouts and positive scorecards.

mint-green-text.description: The green to use when green must be READ. 5.28:1 on white, 4.80:1 on its own tint — AA at any size. Brand mint itself is 1.98:1 on white and must never carry text.

electric-blue-pale.description: Dark-theme text/link blue. 7.04:1 on charcoal, 5.43:1 on the graphite surface.

electric-blue-lite.description: Dark-theme fill (e.g. primary button background, with charcoal text at 5.13:1).

charcoal.description: Primary text on light; page background in dark theme.

white.description: Cards and surfaces in light theme.

steel-lite.description: Dark-theme muted text. 4.91:1 on the graphite surface.

success.description: Value gain, passed check, aligned with client priorities.

warning.description: Value at risk, decision needs review.

warning-text.description: Text form of warning. 5.26:1 on white, 4.76:1 on the amber tint. The #D69E2E fill is 2.39:1 and is never used for text.

danger-text-dark.description: Dark-theme danger text. 6.83:1 on charcoal, 5.27:1 on graphite.

value-risk.$description: Categorical scale for the FMP's value-risk classification (cost / functional / sustainability impact). Ordered low to high so it can drive a legend or a heatmap directly.

high-text.description: Text form of the high-risk orange. 5.31:1 on white.

tint.$description: Tinted backgrounds for callouts, badges and selected rows. Each is paired with its matching *-text colour above, and every pairing clears 4.5:1.

$accessibility: Every foreground/background pair this system recommends was computed against the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula and clears 4.5:1 (AA at any text size), in both light and dark themes. The three exceptions are explicitly labelled fill-only and must never carry text: mint-green #41CF97 (1.98:1 on white), amber #D69E2E (2.39:1 on white) and steel #8A94A6 (3.06:1 on white, permitted for large text and non-text UI only).
